dialog.speaker: npc:clerk
dialog.tr: Hepsi bozuk mu? Peki... sayıyoruz o zaman.
dialog.en: All coins? Okay... we're counting, then.

dialog.speaker: npc:stranger
dialog.en: (behind you, holding a basket with a single loaf)

choices.en: Let the person behind go first

say.tr: Yedi dakikada 132 Para saydın. Son metal para konunca kasiyer alkışladı, arkadaki de.
say.en: Seven minutes, 132 in coins. When the last one went down, the cashier applauded. So did the person behind you.

coach.en: One jar. One round of applause.

arkadaki.tr: Ekmekli müşteri öne geçip teşekkür etti. Sen sayarken iki kişiyi daha öne aldın.
arkadaki.en: The person with the loaf went first and thanked you. While you counted, you waved two more through.

coach.en: Three people through. One jar empty.

kart.tr: Kartla ödedin. Kavanoz eve, bir gram bile hafiflemeden geri döndü.
kart.en: You paid by card. The jar went home exactly as heavy as it came.

wager.reason: check yok ya da wager kotası

intent.setup: yıllardır biriken bozuk para kavanozuyla markette ödeme yapmak
intent.punch: kavanoz bir gram bile hafiflemeden döndü
